notes: Anti-Cheat-Safe Game CPU & Disk I/O Priority: Configured Windows kernel IFEO PerfOptions (High CPU & High Disk I/O) for competitive games (CS2, Fortnite, Roblox, Minecraft, Valorant, Apex, CoD) without anti-cheat blocks
Active DSCP 46 Expedited Forwarding Packet Tagging: Windows QoS policies now actively stamp game UDP packets with DSCP 46 priority and remove the 20% QoS reserve bandwidth
NIC Hardware De-Jitter: Added adapter hardware control disabling IEEE 802.3az Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE), Green Ethernet micro-sleeps, and Flow Control pause frames
PCIe Message Signaled Interrupts (MSI Mode): Added hardware inspection and one-click enablement for GPU and PCIe NIC Message Signaled Interrupts to minimize DPC latency and eliminate IRQ conflicts

Deduplicated Shader Cache Architecture: Partitioned GPU shader cleanup into Stale (>30 days, 22.26 GB, Safe) and Active (last 30 days, 29.89 GB, Caution) for mathematically exact, non-overlapping size calculations
AMD Dual-CCD 3D V-Cache & Intel Hybrid Protections: Preserves 3D V-Cache core parking and Intel Thread Director QoS scheduling
